subQuests.subQuestName: Go to check on the victim

120260102.text: A—An oni!? Oh no, not another one...

120260103.text: Oh — uh, yeah, not the one that robbed you though. So chill. I contacted you before, remember? I need your help.

120260104.text: Oh, right... Sorry, I'm still a bit on edge after the incident. Ahem, so anyway here's what happened. I was just out transporting some goods when a group of ronin suddenly attacked me.

120260105.text: It's not the first time that's happened to me. Usually, you just hand over some Mora and they'll leave you alone. At least you don't lose your goods that way.

120260106.text: But this time was different. They weren't willing to talk things over, instead, they took my things and then started coming for me.

120260108.text: I got down on my knees and begged. Said I had a family to care for and that my business is our only livelihood.

120260109.text: Then I saw that there was an oni among the group. I thought he was gonna be the one to finish me off.

120260110.text: But instead, he stopped the others and told them to let me go.

120260113.text: Yeah. That got them all arguing with each other. His cohort said that I was sure to retaliate if they released me.

120260114.text: But the young oni was insistent that they shouldn't lay a finger on me. Things got real heated — I thought they were gonna come to blows.

120260115.text: Luckily, they let me escape with my life in the end, and I scrambled to get myself here, where I'd be safe. *sigh* I never want to set foot outside of here again.

120260116.text: So he'll steal, but he won't harm people. Hmph, seems he has some sort of standards.

120260117.text: Did he say why they were robbing you?

120260118.text: ...Surely it was Mora, right? What else could they have wanted with me?

120260119.text: I mean, I can't say for sure. It's not like I asked... But what I did hear them say was, "The goods are worth more than the merchant's life," or something like that.

120260121.text: Do you have any idea where they went after they robbed you?

120260122.text: I have no clue, but I think they're pretty active in the Tatarasuna area.

120260123.text: You aren't gonna go after them, are you? Seriously, I'd advise against it... There are too many of them, and they're all heavily armed.

120260124.text: Ah, don't worry, it's just a bunch of no-name scumbags. I got a whole laundry list of scores to settle with them.

120260125.text: If these two islands are where they tend to hang around, we're sure to run into them at <color=#00E1FFFF>Nazuchi Beach</color> sooner or later.

subQuests.subQuestName: Lie in wait at Nazuchi Beach for the ronin to show up

120261201.text: They gotta pass through here some time. So let's just hang tight for a while.

120261202.text: If I'm not mistaken, they'll be showing up any time now.

120261203.text: Yeah, things might get a little rough, so we'd better be prepared.

120261205.text: Yeah, there they are. And one of them has horns.

120261206.text: Alright, it's go time. Let's get 'em!

120260401.text: Whew, we managed to save everyone, but...

120260402.text: What about Itto and Takuya? Paimon hopes they're alright...

120260408.text: What's up with the looks on your faces? I said we'd be okay, didn't I?

120260409.text: I'm sure I'd be looking a whole lot sharper right now if it wasn't for that brutal bean attack of yours earlier.

120260201.text: Hey! Don't even think about runnin'!

120260202.text: It's me. Arataki Itto, descendant of the crimson oni!

120260203.text: Hmph, I know who you are.

120260204.text: From the day we are born, every blue oni knows their purpose. We all know our fate is one of self-sacrifice.

120260205.text: But what about the crimson oni, hmm? You don't know anything about us... Not our miserable history, or any of our names. Mine's Takuya, by the way. But you don't even care, do you?

120260206.text: Because those who get sacrificed should be forgotten, right?

120260207.text: No, you're wrong. I never knew that the blue oni had survived to this day — and the moment I found out, I was determined that I would find you.

120260208.text: Since you remember the pact between our two factions, I assume you also remember the pride we share as oni.

120260209.text: So my question is, how could a proud oni like yourself go and abuse the weak and plunder the innocent? Why break the oath that our kind swore all those years ago?

120260212.text: Heh, who are you to talk about pride and oaths with me?

120260213.text: The blue oni gave up everything! Just so the crimson oni could live peacefully in human society!

120260214.text: But let me ask you, Arataki Itto, what exactly do you contribute to human society?

120260215.text: You're a blundering fool who can't hold down a real job, a laughingstock of the town, and worse still, you let them get your Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree. Protecting the oni pride? Hah! You wouldn't know how if you tried!

120260216.text: You're a disgrace to the oni kind!

120260217.text: Hey, come on, none of that stuff's a big deal, I mean... heh, y—you're, uh, really hangin' me out to dry here, man...

120260218.text: Since when do you care what other people think? You just do whatever you want. It's not like anyone can stop you.

120260219.text: But do you have any idea of the kind of life my kin and I have lived while you've been hanging around in human society?

120260220.text: We were cut off from the rest of the world. We severed all contact with it, and since then we've had no place to live, no stable source of food...

120260221.text: No clothing, no medicine, nothing! Besides the oath we swore to uphold and our so-called oni pride, we had nothing!

120260222.text: So that's why you joined a band of thieves?

120260223.text: That's right. Why should I accept that life? Is holding fast to a worthless oath supposed to help me provide for my family and friends?

120260224.text: I've abandoned our oni pride, it's meaningless. I want to live.

120260225.text: I've given everything that I've stolen from humans to my community. What I've taken will at least keep them from starving and ease their pain.

120260226.text: That's what matters most to me.

120260229.text: Yeah! And besides, the blue oni sacrificed themselves so that oni could be accepted as part of human society!

120260230.text: If people see oni causing trouble again, then that'll defeat the whole purpose of the sacrifice you made!

120260231.text: Hmph, you make a good point. But Arataki Itto's the one who needs to get that into his thick skull.

120260232.text: The blue oni are the bad guys, so we're expected to do bad things. Our actions won't tarnish the reputation of the crimson oni...

120260233.text: Unless, of course, this bonehead decides it'd be a great idea to take all the blame for himself, completely destroying the trust between humans and the crimson oni in the process...

120260234.text: He's the one that's wasted the sacrifice we've made.

120260235.text: Huh!? I only had to do that because of you! I couldn't just stand back and let the Tenryou Commission drag you away!

120260236.text: You should get your priorities straight!

120260237.text: The blue oni are history, alright!? Forget about us! The crimson oni are the ones who must live on!

120260238.text: Why couldn't you have just stayed out of this!?

120260240.text: Oh no! It's the Tenryou Commission!

120260241.text: Ugh, forget it! This was a waste of time anyway.

120260242.text: Look, I don't expect you to understand me. But you could at least take a look in the mirror sometime.

120260244.text: He got away! Uh oh, we need to get out of here, too!

120260601.text: Alright, you're all free to go now! Quick, get to safety!

120260602.text: Sorry, but have you seen our little boy? We're awfully worried about him!

120260603.text: Calm down, dear. We don't even know if he was taken here or not.

120260605.text: Oh, you must be Daisuke's parents!

120260606.text: Yes, that's right! Have you seen him? Where is he? Is he all right?

120260607.text: Don't worry, he's safe and sound. Someone's looking after him now on Yashiori Island. Here, lemme show you on the map.

120260608.text: He's been worried about you, I bet he'll be relieved to see you.

120260609.text: You were the one who saved him? Oh, thank you, thank you!

120260610.text: He's the one you should be thanking.

120260611.text: Hahaha, no need to thank me. It's my pleasure, really. It's just who I am... it's what I do.

120260612.text: Before you go calling me a hero, lemme ask you this: Wouldn't any other self-respecting guy who saw another person in danger have done the exact same thing?

120260613.text: Really... Just one little compliment and it goes straight to his head...

120260614.text: Why did they seize so many people?

120260615.text: *sigh* These vagrants are insatiable. They'll do anything for money.

120260618.text: No one dares stand up to them for fear of what they might do...

120260619.text: W—Would they really do anything drastic?

120260620.text: Um... No, actually, because one of the guys — the one with oni horns on his head — has always shielded us so far.

120260621.text: Oh, in fact, his horns look just like the ones this guy has!

120260622.text: At night, he would secretly bring us food and water. I don't understand what he was trying to do...

120260623.text: Are you a friend of his? Or perhaps a relative?

120260625.text: Oh, maybe there's something secretly troubling him? He seemed different from the rest of the gang... They seem like heartless crooks, but I'd say he comes across more like a confused child who made some poor choices.

120260626.text: Lemme put it this way... There are a few things he needs to straighten out in his head, and I'm here to point him in the right direction.

120260627.text: I'm glad to hear that. He's lucky to have family like you.

120260628.text: Hehe, don't worry, he'll be in my trusty hands. I'll help him see the light.

120260629.text: Anyway, you should scram, it's still not safe here.

120260630.text: Yes, thanks again. You've rescued our entire family... we are indebted to you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Square off against the Tenryou Commission members

120260301.text: Man, they really came out in force today. I'm kinda flattered the Tenryou Commission sent so many...

120260302.text: But I still haven't completely recovered from the bean attack earlier... I'm starting to lose my edge here.

120260303.text: Why don't you let us explain the situation to them?

120260305.text: All that would do is send them after our blue oni friend instead. But, I have to settle things with him first, man to man!

120260306.text: Then what should we do!? The Tenryou Commission's about to arrest you!

120260307.text: Ugh, no choice but to keep kicking some Tenryou butt!

120260308.text: Hey Boss! Thought you'd have all the fun without us, huh?

120260309.text: Granny Oni sent us. We're here to lend a hand!

120260310.text: Maybe we can't take 'em, but we can sure slow 'em down. Now's your chance — go!

120260311.text: Hey! I told you to stay outta this one!

120260312.text: Well, we're in it now. C'mon, there's no time!

120260313.text: Go do what you gotta do, Boss!

120260315.text: Watch yourselves. Soon as I'm done, I'm coming back for you!

120260316.text: C'mon, you two! Time to roll!

120260317.text: Don't let them get away! After them!

120260318.text: Hey! You guys want some of this!? There's plenty to go around!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the footprints and chase Takuya

120261901.text: Just leave everything to me now.

120261902.text: It looks like Granny Oni's about to get a few more oni to look after.

120261001.text: I still think you should leave it alone... they're too dangerous.

120261002.text: Never mind the goods, I'm lucky just to have escaped with my life.

120260801.text: Ah! Hidden entrance! Yes! Alright! I think we just found their hideout.

120260802.text: This is gonna be where they keep all the people they took.

120260803.text: Paimon thinks Takuya's probably in there as well.

120260804.text: Before we go in, I have a question.

120260806.text: Did you really understand where Takuya was coming from?

120260807.text: Heh, of course I did! C'mon, I'm not that dumb...

120260808.text: But it takes a world-class blockhead like Takuya to think his ideas are actually gonna work.

120260809.text: So I'm here to save him, no matter what!

120260811.text: Huh? What were you two talking about? Are you keeping Paimon in the dark again?

subQuests.subQuestName: Ascertain the situation with Arataki Itto
Go deeper into the ronin hideout
Defeat the ronin guarding this place

120260701.text: Bet you think you've won, don't ya?

120260702.text: Haha, so naive! This is my home turf!

120260703.text: I'll let you in on a little secret. A long time ago, I picked up this rare paper charm. It's very precious to me.

120260704.text: What makes it so special is that if you tear one piece, the other piece starts tearing too.

120260705.text: Uh, news flash, don't care about your little origami obsession.

120260706.text: You'd better stay where you are and let me finish!

120260707.text: Aren't you curious what the other piece is used for?

120260708.text: I'll tell you. It's now the critical component of a mechanism, and when it gets torn, this place goes up in smoke! Yeah. The whole hideout is rigged with explosives and ready to blow.

120260709.text: Wha— You're gonna blow this whole place up!?

120260711.text: Oh, don't worry about me. I made sure that I've got an escape route. The rest of you, though... you're gonna be buried deep among the rubble!

120260712.text: You've had your fun. Now it's goodbye!

120260714.text: My paper charm! Wh—Where's my paper charm!?

120260715.text: I'm sorry, are you looking for this?

120260716.text: Yes, that's— But when did you...

120260717.text: I snatched it earlier, to stop you from doing anything hasty.

120260718.text: Why you... And now you're going to betray me!?

120260719.text: You're one to talk. What about burying everyone here? If you ask me, that sounds like you've already betrayed our agreement, no?

120260721.text: You done talking now? You sure? Great, 'cause I am done listening.

120260723.text: Great work, Takuya. You arrived in the nick of time.

120260726.text: I said stay away, or I'll tear the paper charm!

120260727.text: Hey! Okay, okay... fine. Just calm down. What are you doing!?

120260728.text: Just because I won't let him blow this place to bits doesn't mean that I won't do it myself!

120260729.text: Unless you wanna get buried, then leave this place, now! Take everyone here and get out!

120260730.text: Heh, you won't go through with it.

120260731.text: If you were that cruel, then why bother protecting every person you've come across, huh?

120260732.text: I'm not here to reason with you! Go! Just get out of here!

120260733.text: This sacrifice is mine to make, mine alone! Why couldn't you just stay out of it!

120260734.text: No one needs to sacrifice themselves!

120260735.text: Alright, then you tell me, what am I supposed to do!?

120260736.text: I've tarnished our oni pride and abandoned our ancestors' oath. Only sacrifice can restore my pride now!

120260737.text: I chose this path so I could provide for my fellow oni. I was ready to die from the very beginning.

120260738.text: This is between us blue oni! But you... If it wasn't for you, everything would have worked out perfectly!

120260739.text: They're here! We won't let them slip away this time!

120260740.text: Uh oh, there's nowhere else to run!

120260741.text: Hey, Tenryou Commission! I'm the one you're looking for! I did it, I'm behind everything! Arataki Itto is innocent!

120260742.text: You're the ones in charge of detaining criminals in human society, right? I'm sure you can tell who the criminal is here!

120260743.text: Huh! It's like he's trying to re-enact the fairytale! Sacrificing himself for the crimson oni...

120260744.text: Ignore him, he doesn't know what he's talking about! It's me you've been looking for, and here I am! How're you ever going to report back without capturing me!

120260746.text: Listen Takuya, sacrificing yourself won't solve anything.

120260747.text: Your sacrifice can't protect me or your fellow oni. And giving up your life isn't gonna make theirs any longer.

120260748.text: Sacrificing yourself is one way to escape your fate, but the only one you'll be setting free is yourself.

120260749.text: Listen to me! You wanna be the tough guy, huh? Well, this is the coward's way out! Don't let your sacrifice stain our oni pride!

120260751.text: The blue oni have been scraping the bottom of the barrel all these years, so let's give them a new beginning.

120260752.text: We've made mistakes, but we can make up for them.

120260753.text: Fate hasn't been kind to the oni? Well then, let's tear it up and start over!

120260754.text: But before any of that can happen, you need to get yourself behind me and forget about all of that self-sacrifice stuff!

120260755.text: Now, let's go. But we're not done talking about this. Takuya!!!

subQuests.subQuestName: Meet up with Takuya and Arataki Itto
Tell Granny Oni everything that happened

120260501.text: Ahh yes, that does sounds like my Itto.

120260502.text: So... did they take Uncle Itto away?

120260503.text: Yes, they did. But don't be too upset, Daisuke. We will have the chance to see him again.

120260504.text: He and his gang may have acted recklessly, but the fact remains that he still helped us.

120260505.text: Yeah, I knew it! Uncle Itto helped us, and he's awesome!

120260506.text: Now don't get any ideas, Daisuke. Itto is a far cry from "awesome." He still caused a lot of trouble for a lot of people.

120260507.text: If you ask me, I'd say he's like one of those little Onikabuto you kids are playing with all the time.

120260508.text: Though he looks fierce on the outside, he has a kind heart. He's not a delinquent, but he will never back down from a fight.

120260509.text: Uh, I don't really get it, but it sounds like a compliment. I can't wait for my next beetle fight with Uncle Itto!

120260510.text: Thank you, Granny, for taking care of our little boy. I hope that Itto and his friends will be released as quickly as possible.

120260511.text: Yes, you needn't worry. The officials in the Tenryou Commission will certainly exercise sound judgment.

120260512.text: It's time we started heading back. We'll be sure to visit again soon.

120260513.text: Ah, I'm glad that everything was resolved in the end. Things were looking quite dire, but now the future looks bright. Wonderful, wonderful.

120260514.text: As for the blue oni, just leave them to me. If there's one thing an old granny like myself can do, it's caring for others.

120260516.text: Haha, no, no. Go on ahead, I'm sure you have other adventures beckoning.

120260517.text: Besides, once Itto is released, he'll be here to help me.

120260519.text: Oh, yes... And you know what, I think that's what makes him adorable, wouldn't you agree? Hehe.

120260520.text: He does whatever he puts his mind to... He's sincere, brave, and determined.

120260521.text: Back when I took him in, everyone thought I was most unusual indeed. They started calling me Granny Oni.

120260522.text: But I've never been ashamed of this name. On the contrary, I'm quite proud of it.

120260523.text: Because Itto is my pride and joy.

subQuests.subQuestName: Square off against the Tenryou Commission members

120252001.text: Please, you gotta believe me! Uncle Itto didn't do anything wrong, he's not a bad guy!

120252002.text: I'll take care of Daisuke. No need to worry, dear. Everything will be fine.

120269902.text: Hang in there, homies... Hang in there...

120269903.text: As boss of the Arataki Gang, getting rescued by my own boys feels... pretty humiliating.

120269904.text: I promise to never let you down, boys! Alright, we've got some footprints to follow. Let's find Takuya!

120269905.text: It was real touching and all, what they did, but those few guys weren't much of a gang...

120269906.text: Hey, it takes Mora to run a gang, okay? They're all I've got for now.

120269907.text: Huh? Is it just me, or are there more and more footprints here?

120269908.text: At least we know we're headed the right way. Let's see what else we can find ahead.

120269909.text: A wrecked cart and some goods...

120269911.text: Seems they definitely don't want us going any further.

120269912.text: Let's see what's waiting for us up ahead.

120269913.text: Huh, besides the footprints, there are other signs of life here, too. Must be plenty going on around here...

120269914.text: Let's investigate. They couldn't have just disappeared into thin air... unless they're all ninjas or something.

120269915.text: Heh, a child that made some poor choices...

120269916.text: Anyway, let's get going. While we still have time.

120269918.text: Weird, but at least he's not a bad guy.
